content.title: Arguing about Gods
content.author: Graham Oppy (Cambridge University Press, 2006)
content.note: A detailed atheist critique of the ontological, cosmological and design arguments, cited as the critic's own case. Oppy argues that none of the arguments should move a reasonable naturalist. In copyright: described in our own words and cited by chapter or whole work, never quoted; no page numbers are given because no copy is held.
